notes.title: War of the Human Tanks Complete Collection Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5504772/bf7e81abe482c787e98aa653496cc01a6e8db1b8.jpg[/img]
With the release of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/301930]Limited Operations[/url], the third part of the War of the Human Tanks trilogy, a new [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/496/]War of the Human Tanks Complete Collection[/url] has been made available!

This Steam bundle contains all three games, plus soundtracks Sound of the Human Tanks and Sound of the Human Tanks: LO. It allows you to complete the collection easily whether you are getting all the games or already own some of the them. Unlike with traditional Steam packages, you only pay for games you do not yet own.

The bundle gives an additional 10% discount on top of other discounts.

notes.title: Two new Human Tanks games coming!
notes.content:
[b]Human Tanks – ALTeR[/b] is the much-awaited second installment of the Human Tanks, Charge! series, and sequel to War of the Human Tanks. This time you assume command of the enemy of the first game, the Royal Army, and fight back for all you hold dear!

[b]Human Tanks – Limited Operations[/b] is the last of the three games in the Human Tanks, Charge! series. In contrast to the first two games, Limited Operations has the player complete difficult missions with pre-assigned resources and face up against even harder opponents.


[url=http://fruitbatfactory.files.wordpress.com/2014/05/fruitbat-factory-reveals-five-new-games-blog-graphic.jpg]Sneak a peek to the press release image[/url]


These two new installments to the Human Tanks series are going to be released directly on Steam. War of the Human Tanks was localized by Fruitbat Factory and released worldwide September 2012. The Human Tanks, Charge! series is developed by Yakiniku Banzai!.

To add some music to the celebrations, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/271010/?snr=1_5_9__405]Sound of the Human Tanks[/url], music collection for the Human Tanks series, and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/258090/]99 Spirits – Artbook & Soundtrack Pack[/url] can be found [b]-50% off on Steam[/b] for the duration of this week.

(This is a cut from our [url=http://blog.fruitbatfactory.com/2014/05/13/fruitbat-factory-reveals-five-new-games/]latest press release[/url]. Check it out for full details on all of the five games we announced there.)

notes.title: Free Bonus Map Pack live now
notes.content:
Upon launching War of the Human Tanks on Steam, we [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/263400/announcements/detail/1353630101677713847]asked players to design a new map[/url] to be added in celebration.

Out of the submitted designs, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/263400/announcements/detail/1261310736953118059]three unique designs were chosen[/url] to be further polished and created.

[img=http://fruitbatfactory.files.wordpress.com/2014/03/legend-of-the-three-maps.png][/img]

We are now happy to announce version 1.10 of War of the Human Tanks, which includes three all-new maps under Free Battle:

"[b]Hellish Infrastructure[/b]" - fight your way through claustrophobic corridors with enemies all around. Survive till the end for a handy little bonus ([i]Unlocks after Episode 7.[/i])

"[b]Outpost[/b]" - A head-on collision with a difficult enemy force and multiple paths of approach. The enemies here really pack a punch. ([i]Unlocks after episode 11.[/i])

"[b]Ambushed[/b]" - a gauntlet style map with limited deployment and an overwhelming enemy.  Can you take the heat? ([i]Unlocks after Episode 7.[/i])

The maps are balanced to be hard but beatable on first playthrough, and will be unlocked by playing their respective episodes, or if you are already past that point, by progressing to the next episode from where you are. The patch also includes minor tooltip fixes.

In celebration, we are knocking [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/263400/]25% off the price of War of the Human Tanks - Imperial Edition[/url] for 10 days!

notes.title: Map Design Contest Winner Decided
notes.content:
The War of the Human Tanks map design contest winner has been decided!

It was a hard decision to choose a winner from among many great submission, but the jury ultimately ruled in the favor of Dahel’s map ‘Outpost’, impressed by the effort gone into the design. Dahel will receive a unique Human Tanks t-shirt as the reward.

Because the judgement was such a close one, we decided to also craft the maps that placed 2nd and 3rd – designed by Heidi Hokka and Wesley Wong. They will be added to the game as well, and live on in everlasting glory.

To appreciate the contestants’ efforts, everyone who submitted a map design will receive a copy of War of the Human Tanks Imperial Edition.

The work on the new maps has already begun. Look forward to them!

Winners will be contacted by e-mail.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - War of the Human Tanks
notes.content:
War of the Human Tanks is Now Available on Steam!
War of the Human Tanks is a story driven strategy game with a gameplay remiscent of Battleship and Chess, featuring a story of war, loyalty, sacrifice and human shaped tanks.

notes.title: Map Design Contest
notes.content:
To celebrate the game’s Steam release, we are announcing a map design contest for War of the Human Tanks.

The goal of the contest is to design a new bonus map for War of the Human Tanks. The design can be as detailed as you want it to be, as long as it adheres to the physical limitations of the game (maximum map size is 17*17 octagons, all of which can be passable or non-passable), graphical or a written concept, and designed for any difficulty level – up to you! We’ll choose the design we find most interesting and add that map as an extra bonus map to the Steam release of the game (to be found under ‘Free Battle’).

Contest rules:
•	One submission per person
•	The design can be submitted in any form we’ll be able to read
•	Fruitbat Factory may modify the winning design at their discretion
•	Submissions are accepted until 10.2.2014
•	Entries to be submitted to support@fruitbatfactory.com
	
The winner will receive a unique War of the Human Tanks t-shirt, an Imperial Edition of the game on Steam, and the eternal fame of contributing to the war effort!
